articles.title: Vereinbarung mit dem Iran: Ein Deal, der keiner ist und Trump nicht hilft

articles.image_title: Vereinbarung mit dem Iran: June 15, 2026, Tehran, Iran: A child sitting on a man s shoulders waves a flag among pro-government supporters during a state-organized rally in Iran. Iran s foreign ministry said the United States had damaged international diplomatic efforts to end the war after further U.S. strikes on targets in southern Iran, while U.S. President Donald Trump said a deal with Iran could be signed and that the strategic Strait of Hormuz would be open to all immediately afterwards. Iran s Fars news agency, citing a well-informed source close to the Iranian negotiating team, reported that Tehran had not yet made or announced a final decision on any deal.
